A 30-year-old Laredo woman has been arrested on a state jail felony theft charge after allegedly stealing two diamond necklaces worth more than $7,000 from a home where she worked as a cleaning lady, Laredo Police said.

Sarahi Iridian Angeles-Munoz, 30, was served with an arrest warrant on November 3, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail. She is charged with theft of $2,500 to $30,000, a state jail felony, with bond set at $10,000. She was released from the Webb County Jail on November 5, 2026, after posting bond. The charge is an allegation, and Angeles-Munoz is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.

According to Laredo Police, officers responded to a theft report on October 10 at a residence in the 300 block of Jordan Drive. The homeowner reported that her cleaning lady had allegedly stolen two diamond necklaces with a combined value exceeding $7,000.

The Laredo Police Department's Crimes Against Property Unit took over the investigation. Detectives later discovered that Angeles-Munoz had allegedly pawned the stolen jewelry at two local businesses.

Sources: Laredo Police Department; Laredo Morning Times; 24/7 Laredo; Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search.

title: House cleaner arrested after allegedly stealing two diamond necklaces from Laredo home
